businesses.business: physician services (neonatal, maternal-fetal and pediatric subspecialty care)

offering_description.value: Provides physician-led clinical care in hospitals and clinics, including newborn intensive care, maternal-fetal medicine, obstetrics and hospitalist care, pediatric intensive care and pediatric subspecialties. Services are delivered by employed and affiliated physicians and advanced practice clinicians under contracts with hospitals and through office-based practices.

primary_services.value: neonatal intensive care physician services; maternal-fetal and obstetrics care; pediatric subspecialty care; pediatric intensive care and hospitalist services; newborn hearing screening

customer_segment.value: B2C: Newborns, pregnant women and children as patients, billed through insurers; B2B: Hospitals contracting for physician staffing and support, commercial health insurers; B2G: State Medicaid programs as payers for patient care

end_markets.value: healthcare; neonatal care; maternal-fetal medicine; pediatric care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Patient service fees paid by commercial insurers, Medicaid and other payers; service fees: Hospital administrative support payments for physician coverage

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Employs physicians and clinicians who deliver care in hospitals and clinics, paid by payers and hospitals

geography_served.value: US national: Practices in many states across the US, with notable presence in Florida and Texas

specialization.value: related lines: Neonatal, maternal-fetal, obstetrics, pediatric intensive care and pediatric subspecialty physician services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Contracts with hospitals and neonatal units to staff physician services; own locations: Office-based maternal-fetal and pediatric subspecialty clinics

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Physician licensing and healthcare billing governed by Medicare/Medicaid rules, fraud and abuse laws, HIPAA and state medical practice rules
